verified_facts.text: The Los Monteros neighborhood, where the hotel sits, is east of the city of Marbella.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Los Monteros neighborhood, east of the city,

verified_facts.text: Marbella is on Spain's Costa del Sol and is known for its warm climate and beaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marbella, located on Spain's Costa del Sol, is renowned for its warm climate, beaches, and luxurious lifestyle.

verified_facts.text: Kimpton Los Monteros Marbella reimagines the historic Los Monteros hotel and its lively past.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breathing new life into the iconic Los Monteros hotel, reimagining the hotel's vivacious past

verified_facts.text: The rooms were designed by Cristina Carulla's interior studio and use natural light as a fundamental part of the Mediterranean experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Cristina Carulla 's interior studio, use natural lighting as a fundamental part of the Mediterranean experience

verified_facts.text: The Escondido rooftop has an infinity pool with views of the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Escondido Rooftop, relax in the infinity pool with spectacular views of the Mediterranean.

verified_facts.text: The main pool is surrounded by gardens at the Costa Club Pool Bar, with hammocks, Bali beds, live music and DJs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the main pool surrounded by gardens at Costa Club Pool Bar, with over 300 days of sunshine a year, hammocks, Bali beds, live music, and DJs.

verified_facts.text: The Maison Codage Paris Spa has a heated indoor pool with hydro-massage beds and water cascades.
verified_facts.excerpt: Start or end your day in our indoor pool at 33ºC, with hydro-massage beds and water cascades to release tension.

verified_facts.text: The Maison Codage Paris Spa offers facial and body treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge yourself with a exclusive facial or body treatment while enjoying our holistic space.

verified_facts.text: The Racket Club has tennis and paddle courts to rent, and a personal trainer service is available.
verified_facts.excerpt: What better way to start your day than by playing tennis or paddle? Rent your court or inquire about our personal trainer service available throughout your stay.

verified_facts.text: La Cabane by Dolce&Gabbana is a beachfront space designed by Dolce & Gabbana, with food by chef Dani Garcia and private sunbeds and cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience culinary delights crafted by the renowned chef Dani García while relaxing in a space designed by Dolce & Gabbana. Enjoy private sunbeds and cabanas right on the beachfront.

verified_facts.text: Jara, the hotel's fine-dining restaurant, is inspired by Marbella in the 70s.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mediterranean freshness by day and sophistication by night, inspired by Marbella in the 70s.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is included in all room rates.
verified_facts.excerpt: Included in all room rates, our breakfast is a culinary experience by Michelin-starred Chef José Carlos García.

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes any pet that fits in its elevator, and pet accommodation is free of charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: we welcome any pet that can fit into our elevator. However, there is one exception: we cannot accommodate untamed animals or those that may be poisonous. Pet accommodation is free of charge.

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds a BREEAM Very Good sustainability certification.
The hotel offers a complimentary cocktail hour.
There are children's activities on site.
Malaga Airport is approximately 35 kilometers from the hotel.
